cards.text: Jesus is teaching, and look who's crowding in. ALL the tax collectors and sinners are gathering around to listen to Him. And not everybody's happy about it.

cards.question: Somebody doesn't like who's gathering around Jesus. Who starts to grumble?
The Pharisees and scribes are religious leaders. Here's their grumble about Jesus: 'This man welcomes ___ and eats with them.'

cards.text: So Jesus tells them a parable. Lean in, friend.
He says picture a man with a hundred sheep who loses one of them. Now me? If I drop ONE chocolate chip out of a hundred, I'm not even looking down.

cards.question: One sheep is gone and ninety-nine are still in the pasture. What does the man do?

answers.text: Leaves the ninety-nine and goes after it
Stays put and guards the ninety-nine
Sends a servant out to look for it

cards.question: The man searches for the lost sheep only until dark, and then he heads back home.

cards.text: And he FINDS it! He joyfully puts it on his shoulders, and I bet he's grinning like a man who just found his car keys in the last pocket he checked.

cards.question: The man comes home with the lost sheep on his shoulders. What does he do next?

answers.text: Calls his friends and neighbors to rejoice
Builds a stronger pen for the whole flock
Counts all hundred sheep one more time

cards.text: The man tells them, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!' Then Jesus says it's the same way in heaven, and He puts one sinner who repents side by side with ninety-nine righteous ones who don't need to repent.

cards.question: Jesus says there's more joy in heaven over the ninety-nine righteous ones than over the one sinner who repents.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells another one: a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Friend, I spent YEARS lost in the back of a junk drawer under the paper and the dust, so I am rooting for this coin.

cards.question: One silver coin out of ten is missing. How does the woman look for it?

answers.text: Lights a lamp and sweeps her house
Asks her neighbors to help her look
Waits for it to turn up on its own

cards.text: She finds it and calls together her friends and neighbors to say, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.' Hey, the man with the sheep said that too, just with a sheep in it.

cards.question: Then Jesus says it again: in the same way, there is joy in the presence of God's ___ over one sinner who repents.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this batch on the rack for now. Trust me, friend, Jesus isn't done teaching this one.
